records.question: Is this program's commercial target a supportable public-alpha evaluation or a production-supported commercial offer?
records.why_material: The current repository promises public alpha with no production SLA. Support claims, terms, response ownership, compatibility scope and release evidence differ materially between the two postures.
options: Supportable public-alpha evaluation
Production-supported commercial offer

records.question: What is the production canonical process representation and the validation/apply boundary between text and diagram?
records.why_material: The prototype's strict JSON and explicit Apply interaction were experiments. Persisted identity, authoring UX, compatibility and migration depend on this choice.
options: Versioned JSON with explicit Apply
Versioned YAML with explicit Apply
Purpose-built textual DSL
No editable text in first production increment

records.question: How will application-backed MCP execution enforce authoritative surface identity, exclusivity, liveness and lost-client recovery?
records.why_material: The prototype observed two BREP control surfaces consuming one queue and returning inconsistent models. A connected flag does not prove an authoritative application subject.
options: Exclusive renewable lease
Immutable application candidate identity
Application-native transaction/session identity
Disallow application-backed execution until a contract exists

records.question: What executor capability and evidence are sufficient to claim hard tool isolation for an AI step?
records.why_material: Skipping Wright MCP activation and observing no tool call did not prove that the underlying manager could not load other toolsets.

due.before_event: Any live AI execution claim in EPP-F05 or EPP-F06

options: Backend-acknowledged hard-no-tools capability
Dedicated executor that cannot load tools
Do not offer a hard-no-tools claim

records.question: What connection, first-event, first-output, inactivity, total-execution and cleanup deadlines apply by execution profile?
records.why_material: One undifferentiated timeout cannot distinguish connection failure, provider silence, progress heartbeats, total duration or cleanup hang.
options: Fixed profile-specific deadlines
Policy-bounded workflow overrides
Executor-declared defaults with product ceilings

records.question: Who owns output retention, presenter resolution, reauthorization, expiry, cleanup and deletion for each artifact lifetime?
records.why_material: The prototype could complete successfully while destroying or failing to reopen its only useful output. Durable and session outputs require different lifecycle contracts.
options: Workspace-governed durable artifacts plus explicit ephemeral outputs
Run-scoped retention only
Capability-owned retention with Wright references

records.question: Who has independent engineering authority to approve each benchmark oracle family, and what disagreement/quarantine policy applies?
records.why_material: Transport or syntactic success cannot prove engineering correctness; self-authored oracles can confirm the same defect as the implementation.
options: Named qualified domain reviewers per family
Independent standards/reference-tool review
Mixed reviewer plus reference-tool panel

records.question: What exact evidence proves UI-started and headless runs are semantically equivalent?
records.why_material: Prototype paths initially diverged. Comparing only terminal status or output summary can hide different inputs, bindings, events, artifacts or cleanup.
options: Normalized full run-record equivalence
Contract-selected material-field equivalence with declared observational differences
No cross-entrypoint support claim

records.question: Who controls the blind holdout and where do definitions, assets and oracles live beyond development-agent visibility?
records.why_material: Autonomous agents can read committed fixtures. A holdout visible in Git is not blind and cannot detect overfitting.
options: Human-controlled evaluator service/store
Access-separated local encrypted store
External evaluator organization

records.question: What exact customer/process population and claims must the 100-process sample represent?
records.why_material: Without a population and claim boundary, quotas may be convenient rather than representative and 100 rows can falsely imply general engineering reliability.
options: Mechanical-product-development teams
Cross-discipline engineering organizations
Wright public-alpha evaluation use cases only

records.question: What frozen benchmark thresholds, profile mix, repeats and freshness cadence authorize release?
records.why_material: Thresholds selected after results enable retry-until-green and denominator manipulation. The plan proposes all 100 T0/T1 current passes, but live/profile/holdout and first-attempt thresholds require human acceptance before execution.
options: Adopt the proposed all-100 T0/T1 plus declared T2/T3 subset policy
Adopt stricter per-stratum first-attempt and repeat thresholds
Limit initial claims and reduce required live profiles explicitly

records.question: Which third-party process definitions, inputs, artifacts, standards and proprietary-host evidence may be stored, redistributed or used commercially?
records.why_material: A technically representative benchmark or support claim may be legally unusable; blind/proprietary assets also need controlled storage and evidence-only publication.

due.before_event: Any benchmark case is counted or EPP-C01 implementation approval

options: Publicly redistributable assets only
Mixed public and access-controlled licensed assets
Customer-provided evaluation assets under separate agreements

records.question: How must the v2 validator recognize the authoritative v1 revisions 10 through 19 without weakening the approved closed r1-through-r9 bootstrap profile?
records.why_material: The approved profile ends at revision 9, while the governed planning, approval, implementation-start, material-stop, and amended-freeze lifecycle reaches v1 revision 19. Accepting those records silently would change compatibility and append-only-history semantics.
options: Add a closed exact-digest bridge profile for revisions 10 through 19 while retaining r1-through-r9
Replace the bootstrap profile with one closed revisions-1-through-19 profile
Stop EPP-F01 and redesign migration/history semantics
required_evidence: Enumerated revisions 10 through 19 and TR-0009 through TR-0018
Fresh exact material-change and feature-implementation approvals

records.question: What exact source/container, per-gate freshness, multi-module generator identity, and descendant delivery-evidence rules eliminate the dashboard provenance loop?
records.why_material: The approved CLI and schemas cannot unambiguously prove container C from source S, share one gate model, bind a multi-module generator, and represent later independent delivery evidence without a self-reference or regeneration loop.
options: Adopt explicit or constrained inferred container identity, per-gate fresh, a source-bundle digest, and external descendant delivery evidence
Redesign the S/C/D delivery sequence and regenerate the affected contracts
Stop dashboard delivery and ship validator-only scope after reapproval

records.question: How will Wright satisfy the required browser-accessible live program-status page without silently expanding EPP-F01's approved 68-task implementation boundary?
records.why_material: EPP-F01 governs validation, dashboard.json, provenance and CLI reporting but contains no browser route/page; treating the workspace landing page or JSON as the required status surface would hide a user-facing program outcome and change approved scope.

due.before_event: EPP-F01 implementation resumes or EPP-F02 becomes eligible

options: Keep EPP-F01 machine-only and add independent EPP-F01B browser projection
Expand EPP-F01 during implementation
Treat Wright's workspace dashboard or dashboard.json as sufficient
required_evidence: Fresh exact material-change and feature-implementation approvals before EPP-F01 resumes

records.question: May EPP-F01 resolve the stable committed-identity cause only through the exact closed 37-claim append-only correction profile without changing any readiness or release authority?
records.why_material: The six transition digests and 31 state tree pointers are immutable factual defects. Rewriting history, weakening Git identity, or adopting a generic override would compromise control-plane trust and could become a hidden readiness waiver.
options: Accept only COR-EPP-F01-US1-COMMITTED-IDENTITY-001 and its exact 37 factual claims
Stop EPP-F01 and redesign immutable-evidence correction semantics
Reject correction and retain EPP-F01 blocked
required_evidence: Fresh exact material-change and feature-implementation approvals

records.question: May EPP-F01 dispose only the exact TR-0027 /inputs/3 source-versus-container origin defect through a separately approval-bound one-claim profile?
records.why_material: A broad transition-origin exception would weaken append-only history and could admit authority created only in a transition container as if it existed at the source.

due.before_event: EPP-F01 T024 or later implementation resumes

options: Accept only COR-EPP-F01-US1-TR0027-INPUT-ORIGIN-001 and its exact one-claim source/container proof
Stop EPP-F01 and redesign transition evidence semantics
Reject correction and retain EPP-F01 blocked
required_evidence: Exact TR-0027 and approval Git-object identities
Proof that the approval is absent at source and first added at the unique container
Fresh exact material-change and feature-implementation approvals

records.question: May EPP-F01 dispose only the invalid repair-cause identifier at two exact historical state pointers and the truncated TR-0043 digest at one exact TR-0044 pointer through a closed two-claim append-only profile?
records.why_material: The evidence defects are real and immutable, but a broad repair-evidence exception could hide audit failures, rewrite history semantically, or reactivate verification without exact human authority.

due.before_event: EPP-F01 T070, T071, T072 or T066 retry

options: Accept only COR-EPP-F01-REPAIR-EVIDENCE-001 and its exact two claims
Stop EPP-F01 and redesign repair-evidence disposition semantics
Reject correction and retain EPP-F01 blocked
required_evidence: Exact state-revision 45 and 46 Git-object identities and cause-ID pointers
Exact TR-0044 pointer plus independently recomputed TR-0043 digest and blob
Literal two-claim target set with no new records or historical rewrites
Fresh exact V7 material-change and feature-implementation approvals
